Class SimpleBoard

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.core.SimpleBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Board
public class SimpleBoard extends Object implements Board
Implements the Board interface, providing the core game logic for Tetris. It manages the game grid, brick movements, rotations, collision detection, line clearing, and scoring.
